simple.meaning: נְסַק (nᵉçaq) is a Hebrew action word meaning “take up.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 3:22. The surrounding contexts include death, commandment, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְסַק (H5267) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נְסַק (nᵉçaq) / H5267 is traced through Daniel 3:22, Daniel 6:24 with source-language evidence and verse context.
